verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and coding agent, not equity-management or cap-table software. Bulk issuing securities or uploading grants and historical transactions is outside its product category, so this story's axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships any securities-issuance capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time
